scope: Independent exact-row-height controls. Existing 600dpi hypothesis is frozen and tested without fitting these observations; no production rule or whole-page equivalence is claimed.

rangeGetterDiagnostic.scope: Read-only GetPoint of table and cell ranges in a separate hidden reference application instance. Its uncaptured window origin is unknown; range rectangles include selection extent and are not physical frame bounds. Collapsed/empty cell rectangles are 1x1 and table rectangles are wider than the border frame. Do not use these to shift ink.

rejectedPaintCandidate.scope: Isolated original Canvas border painting against cached layouts, without replacing the editor painter. Candidate rejected for four previously correct bottom-edge regressions; no timing or whole-page match claim.
